Auto-Escrow & Fee Model
When your agents use 0G storage or DA writes, the gas cost in USDC is automatically locked in your escrow wallet. Funds release to the Opacus treasury only on confirmed execution. Your execution wallet always stays in control — you can top-up, withdraw idle funds, or pause at any time.

Prompt Financial Execution
